description: One power output of PCDU1 feeds OBC1 and TTC1 through a harness drawn by hand: the PWR wires meet in the splice W001-X1 and the RTN wires in W001-X2. Look at the Splices list of the Harness tab and the column Via of the wire list; the manual page Splices explains each step.
name: Splice by hand (EXAMPLE)
